title: Finite free local factorization of a finite field quotient-extension
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring and K a field in Type u [def-pc-field-extension]. Let rho:A→K make K a finitely generated A-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and have kernel the maximal ideal of A. There exist a commutative local A-algebra B in Type u, free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] and finitely generated as an A-module, with local structural map, and a surjective ring homomorphism beta:B→K satisfying beta composed with the structural map equals rho.

source.place: Tag 07NE (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NE), maximal-ideal specialization; locality as in the first base change of Tag 0EYB

proof.text: Induct on a finite set of A-module generators of K. Maintain a finite free local A-algebra B and a map beta:B→K with maximal kernel, factoring rho and containing the chosen elements in its image. The empty set uses B=A. At the next element x, K is finite over B by restriction of scalars, so x is integral. A monic relation proves that the evaluation kernel in B[T] is not the extension of the maximal ideal. Apply Polynomial.exists_monic_span_sup_map_eq to obtain a monic f whose ideal together with the extended maximal ideal is that kernel.

Form AdjoinRoot f and descend evaluation. Its kernel is the extended maximal ideal by the polynomial-kernel identity and surjectivity of the quotient map. The monic power basis makes it finite free over B. K is finite over this new algebra, so contraction of the zero maximal ideal of K makes the evaluation kernel maximal. Every other maximal ideal contracts to the maximal ideal of B; it contains the extended ideal and therefore equals it. This gives a local ring and local structural map.

Compose finite bases using Module.Free.trans and finite generating sets using Module.Finite.trans. Compose the local structural maps and evaluation maps; old elements remain in the image and the adjoined root supplies the next one. The finite induction ends with the original A-module generators all in the image. The image is an A-submodule because beta factors rho. It contains their span, which is all K, proving surjectivity. All quotients used have carrier Type u.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07NE, finite tower of monic quotients; implemented by finite-generator induction using Mathlib polynomial-ideal generation

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_local_field_factorization
    (A K : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    (rho : A →+* K) (hfinite : rho.Finite)
    (hker : RingHom.ker rho = maximalIdeal A) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (_ : Algebra A B),
      Module.Free A B ∧ Module.Finite A B ∧ IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) ∧
        ∃ beta : B →+* K, Function.Surjective beta ∧
          beta.comp (algebraMap A B) = rho
